create_quadruped_walk_task: create a DM Control quadruped walk task environment with a desired walking speed of 0.5 m/s
create_quadruped_run_task: create a DM Control quadruped run task environment with a desired running speed of 5 m/s
create_quadruped_escape_task: create a DM Control quadruped escape task environment with terrain and rangefinders to navigate a bowl-shaped heightfield
create_quadruped_fetch_task: create a DM Control quadruped fetch task environment with walls and a ball to push to a target
build_quadruped_model_xml: build a MuJoCo model XML string for the quadruped with configurable floor size, terrain, rangefinders, and walls
